evidence_to_collect: Run logs (start time, end time, warnings, model output)
Validation records (expected vs observed, per metric)
Screenshots (when they document something the run logs don't)
User feedback (anonymized per pilot user ID)

pass_fail_signal.rule: Pilot run is 'pass' if all must-pass metrics across all pilot-claim-allowed areas pass. Pilot run is 'fail' if any must-pass metric fails. Pilot run is 'investigate' if any should-pass metric fails and no must-pass metric fails.
pass_fail_signal.note: A 'pass' is a positive internal signal. It is not external validation. It is not a customer reference. It is not production readiness.

contents: Acknowledgement that the pilot is internal validation with a real human user
Acknowledgement that the pilot is not external validation, not a customer reference, not production readiness
Acknowledgement of the no-go claim list
Forbiddance from making any external-claim language about the model
Recording of the pilot user's anonymized identifier
Recording of the pilot user's data isolation requirements
Acknowledgement of the B1 no-go list
Acknowledgement of the B11 commercial messaging guardrail
Forbiddance from making any of the prohibited claims during the pilot
Recording of the no-go categories acknowledged (lender, audit, saas, claim, approval, advice)
no_go_language_acknowledgement.violation_consequence: A pilot user who violates the no-go language acknowledgement triggers a pilot pause and a triage review. The pilot is paused until the violation is investigated and resolved.

rollback_stop_criteria: A pilot-blocker issue that cannot be resolved within the pilot run window
A no-go claim made or implied by the pilot user or operator
A data isolation breach (production, customer, or NDA data accessed)
A security incident (unauthorized access, data leak)
A model output that is outside the documented output range for a must-pass metric and cannot be explained
The pilot user requests a stop
The project lead requests a stop

post_run_evidence_update_handoff.trigger: When the pilot run window closes
procedure: Aggregate per-run evidence into the pilot result summary
File the pilot result summary (per the B9 result summary template)
Update the B3 matrix with the pilot result (current_status, evidence_category, missing_evidence, blockers, notes)
Update the B12 heatmap if any area's confidence label changes
Review the B11 commercial messaging guardrail for any new claim categories
Update the B14 governance refresh tracker with any follow-up items

global_notes: This checklist is empty at package creation. It is the practical launch procedure for the controlled internal pilot. It is not customer reference, not production readiness, not external validation, not paid pilot authorization.
The paid pilot gate (B13) is a separate stage. B18 does not authorize the paid pilot. B18 authorizes the controlled internal pilot only.

Claude review is separate. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is not represented in B18 as completed.

The 5 remaining inline hotspots (POST /projects/{code}/save-as; POST /scenarios/{id}/rename; POST /scenarios/{id}/archive; POST /scenarios/{id}/update-overrides; POST /scenarios/{id}/select) are excluded from pilot scope because they are still inline and are tracked in B17. Future Agent A extractions (51O-51S) will, when they land, update the B17 tracker and may allow future pilot scope to include them after appropriate characterization + extraction + pin refresh.

The allowed data excludes production, customer, and NDA data. The pilot user is bound by the no-go claim list and the B11 commercial messaging guardrail. A pilot user who violates the no-go language acknowledgement triggers a pilot pause.
